profileLabel: Center-left economics (low confidence); mixed on institutions
summary: Iloilo 1st District representative with 75 principal-authored bills. Authored a free school breakfast program and bills postponing and fixing the terms of barangay and SK officials. Co-authored 4Ps expansion, a nutrition program, lifeline electricity rates, fuel-tax suspension, travel-tax abolition, an anti-dynasty ban and a violence-against-women bill.
caveat: Economic score is mostly co-authored. The democratic score nets an authored postponement bill against a co-authored anti-dynasty ban. Violence-against-women bill is a single social issue.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free school breakfast (-2); co-authored 4Ps expansion, nutrition program and electricity lifeline rate (-2 to -3), offset by co-authored fuel tax suspension and travel tax abolition (+1).
